name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A loader pack: the comet ring whose tail breathes as it spins, a staggered dot wave, and ten more — equalizer bars, pulse ripple, orbit, squash-bounce, sine wave, 3×3 grid, typing bubble, counter-rotating arcs, morphing square and an indeterminate line. All native-driver loops, one size/colour/speed API, optional track and an animated-ellipsis label.
